params.name: organization-id
params.description: The unique identifier for the Upwind organization.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of items to be returned.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination to retrieve the next set of results.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Format: `field` or `field:asc` or `field:desc`. Multiple fields: `field1,field2:desc`. Allowed fields: `update_time`, `create_time`. Default: `update_time:asc`.

items.docs: A POST request sent to the search endpoint returns a filtered list of ShiftLeft events that are associated with the specified organization based on the specified search criteria.
